title: Membership of an indexed clause
statement: Let a seedwise three-CNF reduction have a verifier with a finite seed space, and let a seed and an index among its clauses be given. The clause selected by that index belongs to the reduction's formula for that seed.
hypotheses_covered: An index in the range from zero to the number of clauses minus one
